statement: For any prime ell, finite extension E of Q_ell and scheme W, integralTensorRepresentativeReassociate is exactly integralCompletedTensorComparison, with its target functor written as the product good-complex inclusion followed by integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor and then Q.
